physics-killer-02.title: Umsebenzi kunye Nokuguqulelana Kwamandla Omatshini
physics-killer-02.goal: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.
physics-killer-02.material: Ezantsi kwerelsi engenakukhuhlana (ubude $0$) kuqhagamshelwe isangqa esithe nkqo se-loop esineradiyasi $R=4\,\mathrm{m}$. Sifuna ukuyenza into enobunzima $2\,\mathrm{kg}$ ukuba isuke erelsini ngaphandle kwesantya ukuze ijikelezise i-loop kube kanye. Xa $g=10\,\mathrm{m/s^2}$, yeyiphi indibaniselwano echanekileyo ebonisa ubude obuncinci bokuqala $h_{min}$ (ukusuka ezantsi) ukuze idlule phezulu kwi-loop ingabi nako ukushiya irelsi, kunye namandla anomgama ahambelana ngokuthe nkqo $N$ erelsi eyenza kwinto phezulu xa ubude bokuqala bu-$15\,\mathrm{m}$?
physics-killer-02.s.s1.prompt: Ezantsi kwerelsi engenakukhuhlana (ubude $0$) kuqhagamshelwe isangqa esithe nkqo se-loop esineradiyasi $R=4\,\mathrm{m}$. Sifuna ukuyenza into enobunzima $2\,\mathrm{kg}$ ukuba isuke erelsini ngaphandle kwesantya ukuze ijikelezise i-loop kube kanye. Xa $g=10\,\mathrm{m/s^2}$, yeyiphi indibaniselwano echanekileyo ebonisa ubude obuncinci bokuqala $h_{min}$ (ukusuka ezantsi) ukuze idlule phezulu kwi-loop ingabi nako ukushiya irelsi, kunye namandla anomgama ahambelana ngokuthe nkqo $N$ erelsi eyenza kwinto phezulu xa ubude bokuqala bu-$15\,\mathrm{m}$?
physics-killer-02.s.s1.explain: Imeko encinci $N=0$: $mg=mv^2/R\Rightarrow v_{top}^2=gR=40$. Ngokugcinwa kwamandla $mgh_{min}=mg(2R)+\frac12mv_{top}^2$ $h_{min}=2R+\dfrac{R}{2}=2.5R=10\,\mathrm{m}$. Xa $h=15\,\mathrm{m}$ $v_{top}^2=2g(h-2R)=2\cdot10\cdot7=140$. Ukusuka $mg+N=mv^2/R$ $N=m\left(\dfrac{v^2}{R}-g\right)=2(35-10)=50\,\mathrm{N}$. Ukuba usebenzisa ubude $2R=8\,\mathrm{m}$ kuphela, ulibele amandla ehambayo (impendulo engalunganga ①), $N=mv^2/R=70\,\mathrm{N}$ kukungakhathali umxhuzulane (impendulo engalunganga ②), $90\,\mathrm{N}$ ngumlinganiselo wophawu ongalunganga wokudibanisa umxhuzulane (impendulo engalunganga ③).

physics-killer-02.steps.0.prompt: Ezantsi kwerelsi engenakukhuhlana (ubude $0$) kuqhagamshelwe isangqa esithe nkqo se-loop esineradiyasi $R=4\,\mathrm{m}$. Sifuna ukuyenza into enobunzima $2\,\mathrm{kg}$ ukuba isuke erelsini ngaphandle kwesantya ukuze ijikelezise i-loop kube kanye. Xa $g=10\,\mathrm{m/s^2}$, yeyiphi indibaniselwano echanekileyo ebonisa ubude obuncinci bokuqala $h_{min}$ (ukusuka ezantsi) ukuze idlule phezulu kwi-loop ingabi nako ukushiya irelsi, kunye namandla anomgama ahambelana ngokuthe nkqo $N$ erelsi eyenza kwinto phezulu xa ubude bokuqala bu-$15\,\mathrm{m}$?
